textBlocks: TaaSFlow is a subscription recruiting model. We deliver ranked, enriched candidates in 14 days — tracked in a live dashboard, for one flat monthly fee. No placement fees. Ever.
Ranked candidates · Live dashboard · No placement fees
Curious what you receive each week?
Defaults based on industry benchmarks (SHRM, Ashby 2025). Adjust the sliders to match your hiring plan.
Estimates are directional and depend on role volume, salary, package, hiring complexity, and client context. Based on SHRM & Ashby 2025 benchmarks.
Imagine finding someone great. Exactly who you need. But before they even start, you owe an agency $30,000. And you hope it works out. The agency wins either way. You shouldn't carry all the risk.
You pay $25-35k per hire with no guarantee
Hire at $100k = $20-30k fee, plus replacement risk.
Every single hire costs you again
No guarantee the candidate will stick
Mis-hire after 90 days? You pay the fee again.
Start saving on your next hire
Process-driven delivery generates repeatable results. No random sourcing, a managed pipeline system.
You share your role requirements through a guided intake. We capture 47 dimensions — skills, culture, constraints, success criteria — and build a precision blueprint together.
Run structured intake, define scoring criteria, align on targeting strategy
Role details, must-haves, team context, and hiring timeline
We activate outreach across professional networks, curated databases, and proprietary pipelines — engaging passive talent your team can't reach alone.
Launch targeted outreach across 5+ channels with role-specific messaging
Every candidate is evaluated across four weighted dimensions — Role Fit, Evidence, Logistics, and Signal — producing a defensible score tied to your criteria.
Screen, interview, and score every candidate against your blueprint
Feedback on first calibration batch to sharpen targeting
Your first top 10 shortlist arrives — candidates ranked by composite score with full rationale, compensation data, availability, and recommended next steps.
Deliver top 10 ranked candidates with scoring breakdown and pipeline analytics
Review candidates and share interview decisions
See the model in action within days.
Every deliverable is scored, enriched, and explained.
Every candidate scored against your requirements.
Verified background, experience, and fit signals.
See why each candidate matched — evidence, not opinion.
Track every conversation and decision in one place.
Whether you need to fill a critical role or need an ongoing pipeline, we have a flat-fee model that fits.
Receive a scored shortlist in 14 days. Pay once, no ongoing fees.
A subscription that scales with your team. Weekly candidate deliveries.
Flat monthly fee per active role
Toggle each hiring model and compare performance across cost, speed, quality, and scale.
* Scores based on industry benchmarks and customer data
Agency-grade sourcing reach. In-house alignment with your goals. Flat pricing that doesn't punish you for hiring well.
One brief, weekly deliveries, a live dashboard. No cost-per-hire.
Local talent or global reach. Same price.
You brief once. We deliver weekly. Simple.
Every candidate arrives ranked and enriched. You see the reasoning behind every score — never a black box. Qualifiers and disqualifiers filter out non-viable candidates before scoring begins.
Skills alignment, seniority level, domain expertise, and functional background match to role requirements.
Unicorn candidate — exceptional fit across every dimension
Meets basic requirements but has notable gaps
Speed advantage: Clear ranking eliminates 'who to interview first' debates. The scoring has already prioritized.
Teams worldwide trust us for their recruiting
Real companies, real timelines, real cost savings — documented end to end.
SafiTech needed 8 developers before a product deadline. Agencies quoted 3–4 months and $192K in placement fees. We delivered all 8 in 4 weeks — 40% under budget, zero placement fees.
Built careers advising global enterprises. Now applying that same rigor to the world of hiring.

25 years' experience of designing and driving value creation across Fortune 500s and Private Equity. Former Director at UBS Investment Bank and has led strategic programmes for Google, Barclays, HSBC, IBM and AstraZeneca. Very pragmatic and always looking to challenge and disrupt using technology as a key enabler. Strong experience in working directly with leadership teams, enabling growth and execution of business strategy.

Former strategist for Hilton, Marriott, Four Seasons, and Philips. Represented at G20 and B20 forums. Has built and scaled talent acquisition campaigns across the US, LATAM, Europe, and the Gulf. Passionate about employer branding, global talent markets, and building real connections at scale.
Experience the complete system before committing. One role, full execution, scored results.
Strategies and trends to sharpen your talent acquisition.
A direct comparison of traditional talent acquisition and Talent-as-a-Service (TaaS). See where each model wins on cost, speed, quality, and flexibility.
Comprehensive salary data for software engineers from junior to principal, covering every major market, stack, and company stage.
Manufacturing faces a generational talent cliff. Here is how forward-thinking employers are closing the gap with apprenticeships, automation, and creative sourcing.
One flat monthly fee. Ranked, enriched candidates every week. A live dashboard so you always know where each role stands.
Cancel anytime · Keep your pipeline forever
A global hiring system for teams that need consistent recruiting.
Weekly insights into talent acquisition. No spam.
No recruitment agency fees. No placement charges. Subscription-based hiring system.

We use essential cookies for core functionality. With your consent, we use analytics (Google Analytics) and marketing technologies (Meta Pixel, Apollo, Retention.com/RB2B) to understand website performance, improve campaigns, and measure conversions safely. Your data is processed in accordance with GDPR and our Privacy Notice. You can change your preferences at any time.

Ranked delivery · Evidence per requirement · One live workspace
Recruiting agencies send PDFs. TaaSFlow gives you a live workspace where ranked candidates arrive, evidence is one click away, and every action updates for everyone simultaneously.

Compare candidates side by side and decide without exporting spreadsheets or scheduling review calls.
